card.name: Mid-string spots before a number or name continues
card.fires_on: Marked word or symbol sits partway through a URL, name, long term, or numeric expression, such as an equals sign, a slash between doses, or the first digit of a number. The next piece is expected to be a digit or a further name part.

modes.label: Inside numbers and doses
modes.description: A digit, slash, or x inside a dose, size, or range where more digits follow.

modes.label: Inside long names and terms
modes.description: The middle of a chemical term, author surname, or citation.

modes.label: URLs and references
modes.description: An equals sign in a link or a period in a classical citation before a number.

card.writes: It suppresses digit tokens and spaces, so it pushes toward non-digit continuations such as word pieces.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a name, link, or number expression, where the text is not yet finished.
